changes.summary: Added the Senate's 49–50 rejection of H.Con.Res.89 and preserved that the failed measure produced no operative change in military authority or operations.
Added the White House's restoration of CNN, MS NOW and Politico credentials after the temporary order while preserving the unresolved merits and access rules.
Added the administration's filed emergency Supreme Court application while preserving that the justices had not granted a stay or decided the merits.
